draft_entry.summary: Qwen Team announces the first version of QVQ-Max, a visual reasoning model, dated March 28, 2025. Qwen Team states that the model analyzes content in images and videos and reasons over it. Qwen Team reports that accuracy on the MathVision benchmark rises as the maximum thinking length is increased, without giving a numeric figure. The announcement points users to Qwen Chat and lists GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope, and Discord links. It links no system card, model card, usage policy, or paper.
